q: Swachh Bharat Mission was:
options: launched in 1991
a health mission
a housing mission
launched in 2014 and the third phase of the urban component focuses on the waste management
explanation: The Swachh Bharat Mission, launched in October 2014, has the rural component with the ODF+ and the third phase of the urban component with the source segregation and the waste management.

q: PM Fasal Bima Yojana was:
options: launched in 2016 with the subsidised premium of 2 per cent for the Kharif
launched in 2015
launched in 2019
a credit guarantee scheme
explanation: The PM Fasal Bima Yojana of 2016 provides the crop insurance with the premium of 2 per cent for the Kharif and 1.5 per cent for the Rabi and the technology-based yield assessment.

q: Which of the following is correct in the case of the PM-KISAN?
options: It is a crop insurance scheme
It provides a pension of Rs. 6,000
Provides Rs. 6,000 a year in three instalments to the landholding farmer families
It provides a loan of Rs. 6,000
explanation: The PM-KISAN, launched in February 2019, provides the income support of Rs. 6,000 a year in three equal instalments through the direct benefit transfer.

q: Jal Jeevan Mission aims:
options: a skill mission
at a functional tap water connection to every rural household and 55 litres per person per day
a sanitation mission
a housing mission
explanation: The Jal Jeevan Mission, launched in 2019, aims at a functional household tap water connection to every rural household and the prescribed quality of 55 litres per person per day.

q: In the context of the PM-KUSUM, which of the following is correct?
options: Has the three components of the solar pumps, the solar plants and the small solar plants
It is a rooftop scheme for the households
It is a coal plant scheme
It is a large hydro scheme
explanation: The PM-KUSUM has the three components of the 1.6 lakh solar pumps, the 10,000 solar power plants of 1 MW each and the solarisation of the 5.18 lakh small grid-connected plants.

q: In the context of the PM-KMY, which of the following is correct?
options: It is a loan waiver
Provides a monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 to the small and the marginal farmers
It provides Rs. 6,000 a year
It is a crop insurance
explanation: The PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana provides a monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 to the small and the marginal farmers on a voluntary contribution with the matching government contribution.

q: PM SVANidhi provides:
options: the housing loans
the crop loans
the insurance
the collateral-free working capital loans to the street vendors
explanation: The PM SVANidhi, launched in June 2020, provides the collateral-free working capital loans of up to Rs. 20,000 to the street vendors.

q: Consider the following statements. Which of them is correct with regard to the PMJANMAN?
options: It is a scheme of the fisheries
It is a skill scheme
Is the scheme for the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups with the Van Dhan Vikas Kendras
It is the scheme for the urban poor
explanation: The PM-JANMAN, the Janjatiya Nagari Abhiyan, is the scheme for the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups and the Van Dhan Vikas Kendras are the units.

q: Which of the following is correct in the case of the Ujjwala 2.0?
options: It was the city development plan
Extended the PMUY to the additional beneficiaries with the first refill subsidy
It made the LPG free
It was the housing scheme
explanation: The PMUY 2.0, approved in 2021, extended the deposit-free the LPG connection to the additional beneficiaries and it provided the first refill subsidy.

q: Which of the following statements is/are correct in relation to the PM-MKAND?
options: It is the mango export scheme
It is the onion storage scheme
It is a fisheries scheme
Is the scheme of the coconut procurement with the support of the Coconut Development Board
explanation: The PM-MKAND, the market linkage of the coconut procurement, was launched with the support of the Coconut Development Board under the Ministry of Agriculture.

q: The POSHAN 2 Abhiyaan is:
options: the school nutrition programme of the hot cooked meals
a nutrition scheme of the hospitals
a mid-day meal of the private schools
a food fortification scheme
explanation: The POSHAN 2 Abhiyaan, the revised POSHAN, is the school nutrition programme of the hot cooked meals in the government and the government-aided schools.

q: Consider the following statements. Which of them is correct with regard to the SAGARMALA?
options: It is the inland waterway project
It is the industrial corridor project
Is the port-led logistics programme of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
It is the highway project
explanation: The Sagarmala is the port-led logistics development programme and it covers the ports, the coastal shipping, the inland waterways and the logistics parks.

q: The 'National Logistics Policy' was released in:
explanation: The National Logistics Policy was released in 2022 and it is complemented by the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan.

q: IndiaAI Mission was:
options: approved in 1991
discontinued
approved in 2024 with an outlay of about Rs. 10,372 crore
approved in 2021
explanation: The IndiaAI Mission, approved in March 2024 with an outlay of about Rs. 10,372 crore, is the umbrella programme of the AI ecosystem.

q: Provides the rooftop solar with a maximum of 300 units per household and it was launched:
options: the free electricity to all
a state scheme
a smart meter scheme
explanation: The PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, launched in February 2024 with an outlay of Rs. 75,021 crore, provides the rooftop solar of up to 300 units per household.

q: PM Gati Shakti has:
options: the 14 sectors and the 20 key corridors
a highway project
a port project
a telecom project
explanation: The PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan has the 14 sectors with the 20 key multimodal corridors and about 100 projects.

q: National Green Hydrogen Mission has:
options: only the nuclear energy
a state scheme
an outlay of Rs. 19,744 crore and a target of 5 million tonnes by 2030
an outlay of Rs. 1,974 crore
explanation: The National Green Hydrogen Mission has an outlay of Rs. 19,744 crore and the target of a minimum of 5 million tonnes of the annual green hydrogen production by 2030.

q: In the context of the Bhashini, which of the following is correct?
options: It is a scheme of the ISRO
Is the MeitY mission for the digital public infrastructure of the Indian languages
It is a scheme of the education
It is a digital payments scheme
explanation: The Bhashini mission, launched in 2022, builds the digital public infrastructure for the Indian languages with the translation, the transcription and the AI assistance.

q: Which of the following statements regarding the PM-EG is correct?
options: Is the scheme of the electronics manufacturing with the investment of about Rs. 11,000 crore
It is the mobile phone scheme
It is the IT hardware scheme
It is the semiconductor fab scheme
explanation: The Programme for the Electronics Manufacturing with a proposed investment of about Rs. 11,000 crore was approved in 2020 and it is in the PLI.

q: The 'PM E-DRIVE' of 2022:
options: It is a subsidy of the CNG vehicles only
It is a scrappage policy
It is a subsidy of the tractors
Is the electric mobility scheme with a subsidy of about Rs. 10,900 crore
explanation: The PM E-DRIVE, the Electric Mobility Transformation Scheme, was approved in September 2022 with a subsidy of about Rs. 10,900 crore.

q: Consider the following statements. Which of them is correct with regard to the PM MITI?
options: It is a scheme of the education
Is the scheme of the electronics manufacturing and the IT hardware of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry
It is a scheme of the IT services
It is a scheme of the telecom
explanation: The Programme for the Electronics Manufacturing and the IT Hardware of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry was approved in 2020 as a part of the PLI.

q: The Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Benefits and Other Services) Act of 2016 made:
options: the UIDAI a statutory body
explanation: The Aadhaar Act of 2016 made the UIDAI a statutory body and it also allowed the private sector to use the Aadhaar authentication.

q: In the context of the JAM, which of the following is correct?
options: It is a digital literacy scheme
It is a housing scheme
Is the Joint Admission Matrix for the central and the state institutions
It is a financial inclusion programme
explanation: The JAM, the Joint Admission Matrix, is the common platform for the admissions to the central and the state institutions and it was launched in 2015.

q: In the context of the SWAYAM, which of the following is correct?
options: It is a skill development portal
It is a digital payments portal
It is a scholarship portal
Is the national portal of the MOOCs of the Indian universities
explanation: The SWAYAM, the Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds, is the national portal of the free online courses of the Indian institutions.

q: In the context of the DIKSHA, which of the following is correct?
options: It is a skill portal
Is the national portal of the school education with the e-content
It is a digital payments portal
It is a university education portal
explanation: The DIKSHA, the Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing, is the national portal of the school education with the textbooks and the e-learning content.

q: Consider the following statements. Which of them is correct with regard to the UMANG?
options: It is a learning platform
It is a survey platform
Is the platform of the government services for the citizens
It is a payment platform
explanation: The UMANG, the Unified Mobile Application for all the Government services, offers more than 2,000 services and it was launched in 2016.

q: Consider the following statements. Which of them is correct with regard to the DigiLocker?
options: Is the platform of the digital documents of the citizens
It is a payments platform
It is a survey platform
It is a learning platform
explanation: The DigiLocker, launched in 2015, allows the citizens to access the government issued documents digitally and it is integrated with the Aadhaar and the mobile.

q: Consider the following statements. Which of them is correct with regard to the ONDC?
options: It is a payments network
It is a logistics scheme
It is a telecommunications network
Is the open network for the digital commerce with the interoperable protocols
explanation: The ONDC, the Open Network for Digital Commerce, is the initiative of the Department of Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade for the interoperability of the digital commerce.

q: Account Aggregator is:
options: the consent-based financial data sharing system with the Sahamati as the repository
a credit information company
a digital identity provider
a payments gateway
explanation: The Account Aggregator, with the Sahamati as the financial information repository, enables the consent-based sharing of the financial information of the citizens.

q: The 'Stand Up India' of 2016:
options: It is a scheme of the farmland
It is a skill scheme
Provides the bank credit to the SC, the ST and the women entrepreneurs
It is a credit guarantee for the MSMEs
explanation: The Stand Up India provides the bank credit to the greenfield enterprises of the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes and the women entrepreneurs.

q: In the context of the MUDRA, which of the following is correct?
options: It is a scheme of the NABARD for the agriculture
Has the three categories of the Shishu, the Kishore and the Tarun
It has only the Shishu category
It is for the corporates
explanation: The MUDRA has the three categories of the Shishu for the new entrepreneurs, the Kishore for the growing and the Tarun for the established.

q: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana was:
options: launched in 1991
a crop loan scheme
a housing scheme
launched in 2015 to finance the micro units and the small enterprises
explanation: The PMMY, launched in April 2015, provides the loans to the micro units and the small enterprises and it is refinanced by the SIDBI.

q: Startup India Seed Fund provides:
options: up to Rs. 50 lakh for the proof of concept and up to Rs. 20 crore for the growth
the loans of Rs. 1 crore only
a fund of the states
the tax exemptions
explanation: The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme provides up to Rs. 50 lakh for the proof of concept and up to Rs. 20 crore for the scaling up of the startups.

q: Make in India was:
options: launched in 1986
a state initiative
launched in 2014 with the three pillars of the Make in India, the Skill India and the Start Up India
launched in 1991
explanation: The Make in India of 2014 has the three pillars of the Make in India, the Skill India and the Start Up India, and it was restructured with the National Manufacturing Mission in 2020.

q: In the context of the Skill India, which of the following is correct?
options: It was launched in 1991
It is a scheme of the agriculture
It is a housing scheme
Was launched in 2015 with the NSDC and the National Skill Development Corporation
explanation: The Skill India, launched in 2015, is implemented through the National Skill Development Corporation with the target of the skilling of 400 million.

q: The 'National Skill Development Corporation' was set up in:
explanation: The NSDC, a public limited company under the Ministry of Skill Development, was set up in 2009 and it is the apex for the skill development.

q: Jan Dhan Yojana was:
options: an insurance scheme
launched in 2014 and it has the largest number of the basic bank accounts in the world
launched in 1991
a housing scheme
explanation: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, launched in August 2014, has the largest number of the basic bank accounts in the world with the RuPay cards and the overdrafts.

q: The 'Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana' is:
options: The watershed development programme
The river linking project
The command area development of the CADP
The micro irrigation scheme of the per command area development
explanation: The PMKSY is the micro irrigation scheme of the per command area development with the objective of the enhanced water use efficiency and the area expansion of the irrigation.

q: The 'Per Drop More Crop' is:
options: A scheme of the NABARD
A scheme of the state governments
The micro irrigation component of the PMKSY
The drip irrigation subsidy of the Telangana
explanation: The Per Drop More Crop is the micro irrigation component of the PMKSY and it promotes the water use efficiency with the subsidies for the drip and the sprinkler systems.

q: The 'Integrated Watershed Management Programme' is:
options: A programme of the Department of Rural Development for the watershed development
A programme of the Ministry of Water Resources
A programme of the DRDA for the irrigation
A scheme of the MGNREGA
explanation: The Integrated Watershed Management Programme of the Department of Rural Development is a watershed development programme with the 3,000 watersheds in the country.

q: Which of the following statements is/are correct in relation to the MGNREGA?
options: It provides the crop insurance
Provides a guarantee of 100 days of the wage employment and it is the largest of such programme
It provides the rural housing
It provides the social security pension
explanation: The MGNREGA guarantees 100 days of the wage employment and it is the largest of the rural employment programmes of the world.

q: The 'National Rural Livelihoods Mission' is:
options: The mission of the Ministry of Rural Development for the livelihoods of the poor
It is a housing scheme
It is a nutrition scheme
It is a skill scheme
explanation: The NRLM, the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana, is the livelihood mission of the Ministry of Rural Development for the poor and it is the largest of the community-driven programmes.

q: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin provides:
options: the assistance of Rs. 50,000 only
an urban scheme
a rental housing scheme
the assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in the plains and Rs. 1.30 lakh in the hilly areas
explanation: The PMAY-G provides the assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in the plains, Rs. 1.30 lakh in the hilly and the difficult areas and Rs. 1.50 lakh in the Ispir and the tribal areas.

q: The 'PM-DAY' of 2023:
options: It is a nutrition scheme
It is a digital literacy scheme
Is the national mission to strengthen the rural livelihoods of the poorest families
It is a housing scheme
explanation: The PM-DAY, the Pradhan Mantri Divya Bazaar Yojana, was approved in 2023 to strengthen the rural livelihoods of the poorest families through the community infrastructure.
